title: Career Path
name: Job Searching and Employment Platform
description: Career Path is a job searching platform developed as a team project under my leadership (July 2025). The platform provides seamless job search functionality and features a subscription-based payment system integrated with Stripe. It includes a comprehensive dashboard for both Admins and Employers, offering full control over jobs and users. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Redux RTK Query, Tailwind, Zod, and Jspdf, the project ensures strong type safety, efficient state management, and a modern, responsive UI. API development and testing were managed with Postman, while the client and server sides were structured to support scalability and secure operations.
